svg.text: B/C mature X overlap · local conflict atlas
Exact saved slots and X masks. Each color marks an overlap-connected component; every X has equal status. No winner or commit is selected.
Each tile shows the registered 96×96 X cell geometry on a neutral grid; hues are component labels only, not B/C material properties.

g.text: Criterion: Max singleton component count, then more global options, then earliest.
Criterion: Largest connected overlap component by member X count, then union-cell count, then earliest.
Criterion: Max options, then min largest component, then max singleton count, then earliest.
Earliest {B,C} node with an overlap edge to another unique X.
No slot contained a coeval {B,C} option with an overlapping distinct X.
Criterion: Earliest pure B/C pair sharing an F component but no X cells.
Criterion: Longest unambiguous contested component chain; use its final observation.
Criterion: Longest exact X mask run that remains singleton at adjacent slots; use its final observation.
